metadata.domain: Cathode Materials / Advanced Materials / Battery Materials

evidence.trl_pathway: TRL progressions are generally plausible: T01 (TRL 6) over 2 years, T02 (TRL 5) over 2 years with T01 prerequisite, and T03 (TRL 4) over 4 years are all within acceptable industry norms for battery materials development, with no extreme jumps visible.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared 기술선도 strategy is partially reflected through inclusion of lower-TRL exploratory materials (T03 at TRL 4, T02 at TRL 5), but the portfolio is small (only 3 technologies) and T01 at TRL 6 is more near-market; the R&D-heavy, exploratory breadth expected of a true technology leadership strategy is insufficient.
evidence.competitive_awareness: There is no explicit articulation of competitor positioning, differentiation rationale, or competitive gap exploitation in the roadmap; technology selections cover mainstream battery material areas (high-Ni, solid-state, sodium-ion) without demonstrating targeted competitive timing or white-space strategy.
evidence.market_timing: For 기술선도, completions 1-2 years before boom are ideal; T01 completes 0.75yr after boom (slight miss), T02 completes 1.5yr after boom (miss), and T03 completes 1.0yr after boom (miss) — all technologies complete after their respective boom windows rather than before, which is contrary to a preemption strategy.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The three selected technologies (high-Ni cathode, solid-state cathode, sodium-ion anode) are all active areas of both patent filing and market growth, suggesting some convergence awareness, but there is no explicit evidence that convergence-zone targeting was a deliberate selection criterion.

strengths: TRL progression timelines are realistic and dependencies are properly sequenced (T02 correctly follows T01)
Portfolio covers three distinct and strategically relevant battery material segments with no budget violations
weaknesses: All three technologies complete after their market boom windows, which is misaligned with both 기술선도 preemption logic and 시장이익최대 timing precision
The portfolio is too narrow (only 3 technologies) for a genuine technology leadership strategy, lacking early-stage exploratory or disruptive candidates
missing_technologies: 리튬-황 전지 양극 소재 (Lithium-sulfur cathode materials, lower TRL for true R&D leadership)
망간계 양극재 (Mn-rich cathode, emerging patent activity with cost advantage differentiation)
전고체 전해질 소재 (Solid electrolyte materials, critical enabling technology for T02)
investment_issues: T03 is assigned Tier=High despite having the lowest TRL (4) and highest uncertainty (4.0); for 기술선도, this highest-uncertainty early-stage technology arguably warrants Strategic tier to signal commitment to exploratory R&D
All budget is fully consumed with only 3 technologies, suggesting over-concentration; a technology leadership portfolio typically diversifies across more early-stage bets
timing_issues: T02 (고체전지 양극 소재 최적화) completes 1.5 years after its market boom (2028-Q3), missing the preemption window entirely for a 기술선도 strategy
T03 (나트륨 이차전지 음극 소재) completes exactly 1 year after boom (2029-Q1 vs 2030-Q1), losing first-mover advantage
T01 completes 0.75 years after boom; starting development earlier (e.g., 2025-Q1) could have aligned completion ahead of the 2027-Q2 boom
